answer: Yes. If you sign the lease buyout authorization, form NW-LSE-1, we'll ask Summit Auto Lease for the dealer payoff quote for you, so you won't have to call them. That's the quote we need, and it can be different from the payoff Summit gives you directly. Summit Auto Lease allows third-party buyouts. If our offer is higher than the buyout amount, Summit passes the difference (lease equity) to you. If our offer is lower, you pay the difference at the appointment.
